heading: Today
text: Mostly cloudy, with showers moving in from the south nearing Route 2 by the late afternoon hours. Highs from the low 60s south to near 70 north. Northeast wind 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph mainly over the southern Greens.

heading: Tonight
text: Rain showers south of Route 4, more scattered north. Lows in the 40s to low 50s. Northeast wind near 10 mph, gusting 20 to 25 mph, stronger gusts possible south.

heading: Sunday
text: Rain south of Rt. 4, a good chance north, becoming more scattered north of Route 2. Highs in the upper 50s south, rising into the mid-60s north. Northeast wind 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph, stronger gusts possible south.
